test_title: PYST 55: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'GRAPE' is coded as 21 - 54 - 3 - 48 - 15 and 'MELON' is coded as 39 - 15 - 36 - 45 - 42. How will 'PEACH' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/272dbdc98ea39c3a3652579a0c6907990873bce8d9ba46d5c8a91d2f5acbd2a9.png] ​

Logic: Positional value of the letters is multiplied by 3.

'GRAPE' is coded as '21 - 54 - 3 - 48 - 15'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ce11b6d5547ff17c5592e1ba1935ac1b0a1020be6038c2e3442a1bb05f28181.png] 

'MELON' is coded as '39 - 15 - 36 - 45 - 42.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36939477f0733f3fb36b16339d3fa1414fff5d6fcb671344779f34f4e228dd54.png] 

Similarly, for **'PEACH'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0da6172f5370bc9a724c5b82e51d59d2b1e1bd9d7fc56d96218cf95ede84a62f.png] 

So,** 'PEACH' **will be coded as '48 - 15 - 3 - 9 - 24 '.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
